entities.name: Werner Döring
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Werner Döring was a German theoretical physicist. From 1963 until his retirement in 1977, he was a full professor (Ordinarius) at the Universität Hamburg. His main interest was the theory of magnetism. His textbooks on theoretical physics have influenced several generations of students.

entities.summary: Werner Döring was a German theoretical physicist. From 1963 until his retirement in 1977, he was a full professor (Ordinarius) at the Universität Hamburg. His main interest was the theory of magnetism. His textbooks on theoretical physics have influenced several generations of students.
